title: Ohne-Makler Property Search Scraper
description: Find German property listings on Ohne-Makler with prices, rooms, area, location, coordinates, and listing links. Batch city searches and page through local results.

batch.title: German locations
batch.description: City, postal code, county, or state names to resolve on Ohne-Makler.
batch.valueDescription: place query used for this property search.

schema.description: Free-text location: postal code (80331), city (München), Kreis, or Bundesland. Results are limited to the resolved place (returned as location). State/city segments are not accepted alongside q.

Property type slug: wohnung, haus, grundstueck, zimmer, buero, einzelhandel, gastronomie, lagerhalle, landwirtschaftliches-objekt, wohnen-auf-zeit, gewerbliche-freizeitimmobilie, zinshaus-rendite, sonstiges, immobilie. Required unless q is used.
kaufen (buy) or mieten (rent). Required unless q is used.
Bundesland URL slug (transliterated umlauts, e.g. baden-wurttemberg). Omit for a Germany-wide class.
City or Kreis URL slug; requires state.
1-based result page. Beyond the last page returns a non-billable 404.
Umkreis in km: 0, 10, 25, 50, or 100. Applies when q resolves to a city, or with state + city. Postal codes, Kreise, and states have no Umkreis (non-billable 422 radius_requires_city).

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Ohne-Makler by German city and property type for prices, rooms, area, location, and links. Batch searches and page through local property results.
storeCopy.intro: Search Ohne-Makler by German city, postal code, county, or state. Collect listing prices, rooms, living area, location, coordinates, and links across result pages.
useCases: Home seekers can compare listings by location, room count, and living area.
Property investors can monitor German supply by city and transaction type.
Housing researchers can export asking prices and coordinates for market analysis.
howToUse: Add a German place name or postal code to `locations` for each search.
Choose a property type and buy or rent transaction, then set optional price and area filters.
Set `maxPages` and `maxResults`, then export the listing rows.

faqs.question: Can I search by postal code?
faqs.answer: Yes. The location query accepts a city, postal code, county, or German state. A radius filter applies only when the location resolves to a city.
